title: GTA 6 : le télétravail prend racine
lead: GTA 6 est annoncé pour le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series. Dans notre bureau imaginaire, Rémi Demain a confié la continuité du service à un ficus. La passation s'est bien passée : aucune demande d'augmentation.

source.title: GTA 6 : A deux jours de la sortie, attention aux arnaques

alt: Rémi Demain, manette sous le bras, règle un casque de bureau sur un ficus installé à sa place devant l'ordinateur. Il montre fièrement son remplaçant.
imagePrompt: Original humorous editorial cartoon of a fictional office handover, with a clear single visual joke. Character Remi Demain: An original fictional cartoon office worker with a small round head, short curly dark hair, large round orange glasses, a teal hoodie over a white shirt, dark purple trousers and orange sneakers. No resemblance to any real person. In a simple contemporary office, Remi stands beside his desk, already wearing a small backpack and carrying a plain unbranded purple game controller under one arm. With his free hand he proudly adjusts a plain telephone headset onto a lush green ficus plant. The ficus is in a terracotta pot sitting on the office swivel chair, directly in front of a desktop computer, as if replacing the employee at work. The headset rests visibly among the leaves. Remi beams with absurd managerial pride and gestures toward his botanical replacement. The plant is a normal plant, no face or human body. The computer monitor faces away from the viewer.
